rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for wild, uncultivated land.

example.english: This wilderness preserves its original ecological environment.
example.traditional: 呢片荒野保存住原始嘅生態環境。
example.jyutping: nei1 pin3 fong1 je5 bou2 cyun4 zyu6 jyun4 ci2 ge3 sang1 taai3 waan4 ging2

rows.note: Pick this when emphasizing land that is barren, unused, or left uncultivated rather than a natural wilderness.

example.english: This barren wilderness has been left unused for many years, and nothing can grow there.
example.traditional: 呢幅荒地丟空咗好多年，乜都種唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 fong1 dei6 diu1 hung1 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 mat1 dou1 zung3 m4 dou3

rows.note: Pick this for a remote, mountainous wilderness, especially when stressing that it is far from civilization.

example.english: They went camping in the wilderness and did not see anyone for several days.
example.traditional: 佢哋走入荒山野嶺露營，幾日都見唔到人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zau2 jap6 fong1 saan1 je5 leng5 lou6 jing4 gei2 jat6 dou1 gin3 m4 dou3 jan4
